Connect an AI client

JumpStart MCPChecking AI bridge

Checking the local MCP bridge.

Start JumpStart with make up, then sign in to your AI client. No model API key is needed.

Codex

From the JumpStart project root, run:

make codex-install

Claude Code

From the JumpStart project root, run:

make claude-install

Cursor

From the JumpStart project root, run:

make cursor-install

Antigravity CLI

Add this entry to ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json. Replace the sample path with the absolute path to this checkout:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "jumpstart": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/absolute/path/to/jumpstart-3d/mcp/server/stdio-proxy.mjs"]
    }
  }
}

In agy, run /mcp to check the connection.

AI connection status

Focus or hover the label to read its state. Open AI setup for client instructions.
